definitions.explanation: A prolonged debate or disagreement, especially one conducted publicly; an argument about important issues.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}について{論争|ろんそう}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The controversy over this issue continues.

examples.japanese: {学者|がくしゃ}たちが{論争|ろんそう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた。
examples.english: The scholars engaged in a heated debate.
examples.notes: 論争を繰り広げる = to engage in a dispute

examples.japanese: {政治的|せいじてき}な{論争|ろんそう}を{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid political controversies.

notes:
USAGE: {論争|ろんそう} refers to serious disputes or controversies, typically about intellectual, political, or social matters.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{論争|ろんそう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる (to engage in a dispute)
・{論争|ろんそう}が{起|お}こる (a controversy arises)
・{論争|ろんそう}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to cause controversy)
・{論争|ろんそう}の{的|まと} (subject of controversy)

CONTRAST:
・{論争|ろんそう} - intellectual/public dispute
・{議論|ぎろん} - discussion, debate (more neutral)
・{口論|こうろん} - verbal quarrel (more emotional)
